story_text: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Create a task and assign a category
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign the category "WORK".
2. Verify that the task is created successfully and the category is assigned correctly.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · category field in response equals "WORK"

positive.title: Edit a task and update its category
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign the category "WORK".
2. Edit the task and update its category to "PERSONAL".
3. Verify that the task category is updated correctly.

positive.title: Create a task without assigning a category
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report".
2. Verify that the task is created successfully and the category field is null or empty.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · category field in response is null or empty

negative.title: Create a task with an invalid category
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign an invalid category "INVALID_CATEGORY".
2. Verify that the API returns an error response indicating the category is invalid.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error message indicating invalid category

edge.title: Create a task with a category that exceeds the maximum length
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign a category that exceeds the maximum length (e.g., a string of 256 characters).
2. Verify that the API returns an error response indicating the category exceeds the maximum length.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error message indicating category exceeds maximum length

edge.title: Create task with category in wrong case (e.g., "work" instead of "WORK")
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign the category "work" (lowercase).
2. Verify that the API handles the category case correctly.
edge.expected_result: 200 OK with case-insensitive match or 400 — must be consistent and documented

edge.title: Create task with null category
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign a null category.
2. Verify that the task is created successfully and the category field in the response is null.
edge.expected_result: 201 Created · category field in response is null

edge.title: Create task with category as an integer
steps: 1. Create a new task with the title "Finish report" and assign the category as an integer.
2. Verify that the API returns an error response indicating the category type is invalid.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error message indicating invalid category type
